 Job Description
 Our Senior GCP specialists are responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting backend services that ensure reliability, security, and scalability across all platform layers. They bring expertise in virtualization, cloud platforms, storage solutions, cybersecurity, and automation through scripting and automation.
 As a Senior DevOps Consultant with GCP at Endava you will have the following responsibilities:
Work with customers and lead the application migrations to GCP
Create infrastructure architectures and technical documentation 
Lead cross-functional technical teams, e.g. cloud engineers and database engineers across geographies
Act as the primary technical point of contact for customer’s stakeholder
Embed security, compliance, and governance into design and delivery
Design target state architectures covering application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers
Drive automation for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and testing
Manage technical dependencies and mitigate risks during application migration
Identify technical risks and issues early, propose mitigation strategies, and track to resolution
Define migration strategy (lift-and-shift & modernization) and target state architectures
Govern delivery quality, risk management, and automation best practices
 Qualifications
Proven cloud migration delivery for large-scale enterprise workloads in regulated industries
Experience with architecture services
Deep understanding of GCP core services (Compute, Storage, Networking, Databases, Security)
Strong IaC expertise, e.g Terraform
Experience with Kubernetes and database migrations
Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps, Cloud Build) for infrastructure automation
Knowledge of data integration, ETL tools such as Informatica, and pipeline modernization for cloud
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
 Preferred Certifications:
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
